recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to a light gray (#F0F0F0).
2. Draw a thin red (#FF0000) rectangle border around the entire slide perimeter.
3. Place a yellow (#FFFF00) filled circle with a black outline in the top-right corner and add the black numeral '9' centered inside it.
4. Create two equal-width rectangular panels side by side in the middle of the slide, each with a dark (near-black or dark-blue) thin border.
5. Inside the left panel, draw a scatter-plot area with a light-gray grid (#CCCCCC). Add red (#FF0000) arrow shapes for the x-axis and y-axis.
6. In the left panel, scatter approximately 10–12 orange (#FFA500) filled circles in a loose linear trend from lower-left to upper-right.
7. Draw a blue (#0000FF) straight fitted line through the left-panel points, tilted to pass near most points but leaving one clear outlier above it.
8. Add one solid red (#FF0000) filled circle above the left-panel line to represent the outlier.
9. Add thin red (#FF0000) arrows from the fitted line to several nearby orange points to depict residuals.
10. Add a white or very-light-blue (#E0F0FF) rectangular text box near the top of the left panel containing the black text '50.85² = 2585'.
11. Add a vertical red (#FF0000) arrow to the left of the red outlier with the black text '50.85 mm' written vertically beside it.
12. Inside the right panel, draw a matching scatter-plot grid and red axes.
13. Scatter orange (#FFA500) filled circles in a clear linear trend and draw a blue (#0000FF) fitted line that follows the general pattern without bending toward outliers.
14. Add thin red (#FF0000) residual arrows from the right-panel line to the points.
15. Add a white/light-blue text box near the top of the right panel containing '63.64² = 4050'.
16. Add a vertical red (#FF0000) arrow labeled '63.64 mm' beside the right-panel line.
17. Below the left panel, add two lines of bold red (#FF0000) serif text: 'Overfit (try to minimize the residuals ONLY)' and 'Fails to detect the Pattern'.
18. Below the right panel, add two lines of bold red (#FF0000) serif text: 'Generalized (Residuals are not minimized)' and 'Successes to detect the Pattern'.
19. Ensure all text uses a serif font (e.g., Times New Roman); captions are bold, equations are regular weight.
